Experiment_description: A series of experiments were conducted to implement a basic feedforward neural network model using PyTorch, aimed at addressing missing data imputation on synthetic datasets using a score matching approach. The performance was evaluated using Mean Absolute Error (MAE) with results visualized through loss plots.
Significance: These experiments are critical as they establish the foundational effectiveness of a feedforward neural network for missing data imputation. The near-zero convergence of loss values indicates that the model is well-implemented and ready for further refinements or applications to more complex datasets, providing a robust starting point for additional research.
Description: The experiments involved developing a basic deep learning model implemented in PyTorch, focused on predicting missing values in synthetic datasets. The model evaluated performance using the MAE metric, with training and validation loss curves plotted over epochs. Consistent results across nodes indicate effective learning, appropriate hyperparameter selection, and good generalization capabilities.
